_meta.description: GradedFacts DE Source Registry — German federal statistical bodies, parliament, constitutional court, public broadcasting, and leading news outlets with independence and quality assessments.
_meta.methodology: Same tier and independence criteria as the US registry. Tier: primary = original data or official records produced by the institution; secondary = journalism citing primary sources; tertiary = aggregation or opinion. Independence: not implied by official status — assessed on documented editorial or operational independence from political direction.

schema.is_independent: true when no documented editorial control by political actors with a direct stake in outcomes
schema.affiliation_note: required when is_independent is false; explains the documented dependency
